```{r load data}
Data.MDS<-read.table("mds/all_crosses_mds.mds", header = TRUE)

# Cleanup Data.MDS$FID and Data.MDS$IID. Replace "_" with "/"
Data.MDS$FID<-gsub("_", "/", Data.MDS$FID)
Data.MDS$IID<-gsub("_", "/", Data.MDS$IID)

# replace mm10 wit C57BL/6J
#Data.MDS$FID<-gsub("mm10", "C57BL/6J", Data.MDS$FID)
#Data.MDS$IID<-gsub("mm10", "C57BL/6J", Data.MDS$IID)

Data.MDS$Group<-Data.MDS$FID

# replace any Data.MDS$Group entries that contain "CC0" with "RI"
Data.MDS$Group[grepl("CC0", Data.MDS$Group)]<-"RI"

Data.MDS$Class<-Data.MDS$Group

# replace any Data.MDS$Group entries that are not "RI" with "Founder"
Data.MDS$Class[!grepl("RI", Data.MDS$Class)]<-"Founder"

# add assembly completness column
Data.MDS$T2T<-ifelse(grepl("T2T", Data.MDS$Group), "T2T", "Non-T2T")

# replace C57BL/6J/T2T/Keane with C57BL/6J and CAST/EiJ/T2T/Keane with CAST/EiJ
Data.MDS$Group<-gsub("C57BL/6J/T2T/Keane", "C57BL/6J", Data.MDS$Group)
Data.MDS$Group<-gsub("CAST/EiJ/T2T/Keane", "CAST/EiJ", Data.MDS$Group)

# replace GRCm39 with C57BL/6J
Data.MDS$Group<-gsub("GRCm39", "C57BL/6J", Data.MDS$Group)
```

```{r plot mds - PC1~PC2, include=TRUE, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
PCA.THEME<-theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill="white"),
  panel.grid.major=element_line(color="gray95", linetype="solid", linewidth = 0.75), #adds major grid lines
  panel.grid.minor=element_line(color="gray95", linetype="solid", size=0.5), #adds minor grid lines	
  panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="black", linewidth=2.5, linetype="solid"), #draws a black border around plot
  axis.line=element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9.6),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9.6),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 9.6),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.025, "in"),
  # axis.text.x=element_text(face = "bold"), #changes x-axis text size and color
  # axis.text.y=element_text(face = "bold"), #changes y-axis text size and color
  axis.title.x=element_text(face = "bold", size=12), #changes x-axis title size and color
  axis.title.y=element_text(face = "bold", size=12), #changes y-axis title size and color
)

Data.MDS$Class <- as.factor(Data.MDS$Class)

# Create a data frame for the triangle
## Making each vertex the average of the 3 subspecies
triangle_df <- data.frame(
  C1 = c(
  subset(Data.MDS, IID=="PWK/PhJ")$C1,
  subset(Data.MDS, IID=="CAST/EiJ")$C1,
  mean(subset(Data.MDS, Group!="PWK/PhJ" & Group!="CAST/EiJ" & Class == "Founder" )$C1)
  ),
  C2 = c(
  subset(Data.MDS, IID=="PWK/PhJ")$C2,
  subset(Data.MDS, IID=="CAST/EiJ")$C2,
  mean(subset(Data.MDS, Group!="PWK/PhJ" & Group!="CAST/EiJ" & Class == "Founder" )$C2)
  )
)

triangle_outline<-rbind(triangle_df, triangle_df[1,])


Data.MDS$color <- "#000000"
# Assign specific colors for the groups (not used in the plots below)
Data.MDS$color[grep("CAST", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#009E73"  
Data.MDS$color[grep("PWK", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#D55E00"
Data.MDS$color[grep("WSB", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#CC79A7"
Data.MDS$color[grep("129S1", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#E69F00"
Data.MDS$color[grep("A_J", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#F0E442"
Data.MDS$color[grep("C57", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#555555"
Data.MDS$color[grep("NOD", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#0072B2"
Data.MDS$color[grep("NZO", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#56B4E9"
Data.MDS$color[grep("RI", Data.MDS$Group)] <- "#8B966C"


# Create color object for the plot
GRAPH_COLORS <- c("#009E73", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#E69F00", "#F0E442", "#555555", "#0072B2", "#56B4E9", "#8B966C")
GRAPH_SHAPES <- c(19, 19, 19, 19, 19, 15, 19, 19, 17)


Data.MDS$Group <- factor(Data.MDS$Group, levels = c("CAST/EiJ", "PWK/PhJ", "WSB/EiJ", "129S1/SvImJ", "A/J", "C57BL/6J", "NOD/ShiLtJ", "NZO/HlLtJ", "RI"), ordered = TRUE)

ggplot(Data.MDS, aes(x = C2, y = C1, color=Group, shape=Group)) +
  geom_polygon(data = triangle_df, aes(x = C2, y = C1), fill = "#aaaaaa", alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  geom_path(data = triangle_outline, aes(x = C2, y = C1), 
              color = "#444757", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +  
  geom_point(size = 2.5, stroke=0, aes(color = Group)) +
  # label the points
  #geom_text_repel(aes(label = IID), size = 2, hjust = 0, vjust = 0) +
  xlab("C2") +
  ylab("C1") +
  #scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")+
  scale_color_manual(values = GRAPH_COLORS) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = GRAPH_SHAPES) +
  # Make plot lines thicker
  theme(element_line(size = 4))+
  # shrink legend size
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "cm"))+
  PCA.THEME-> pc_1_2_plot

# Extract the legend as separate grob
legend <- get_legend(pc_1_2_plot)

# remove the legend from the plot
pc_1_2_plot <- pc_1_2_plot + theme(legend.position = "none")

# create blank element for the legend
blank_element <- ggplot() + theme_void()

pc_1_2_plot +
  ggtitle("") +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", margin = margin(l=75, t = 0, b=2.5)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1)),
    plot.margin = margin(t=2.5, r=4, b=10, l=0.5),             # optional: remove outer plot margin
  ) ->pc_1_2_plot

pc_1_2_plot
```

```{r generate focused MDS plot, include=TRUE, fig.width=4.25, fig.height=4}
# Calculate the min

# Subset the data to only include the domesticus founders
subset(Data.MDS, Class == "Founder" & !(Group %in% c("CAST/EiJ","PWK/PhJ"))) -> Domesticus_Founders

# Calculate the min and max values for PC1 and PC2
min(Domesticus_Founders$C1)->min_PC1
max(Domesticus_Founders$C1)->max_PC1

min(Domesticus_Founders$C2)->min_PC2
max(Domesticus_Founders$C2)->max_PC2

minBound_PC2<-min_PC2*1.1
maxBound_PC2<-max_PC2*0.9
minBound_PC1<-min_PC1*1.1
maxBound_PC1<-max_PC1*0.95

#minBound_PC2<--0.2
#maxBound_PC2<-0.2
#minBound_PC1<--0.09
#maxBound_PC1<--0.05

# make the plot
ggplot(Data.MDS, aes(x = C2, y = C1, color = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, stroke = 0) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = IID), size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, vjust = 0, segment.size = 0.25) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(minBound_PC2, maxBound_PC2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(minBound_PC1, maxBound_PC1)) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = GRAPH_COLORS) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = GRAPH_SHAPES) +
  #scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  JFMVTheme +
  PCA.THEME +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # removes x-axis numbers
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # removes y-axis numbers
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA, color="#555757", linewidth=2, linetype="solid")
  ) -> pc_1_2_plot_focused

pc_1_2_plot_focused
```

```{r make inlayed plot, include=TRUE, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
FocusedAreadRect<-annotate("rect",
           xmin = minBound_PC2, xmax = maxBound_PC2,
           ymin = minBound_PC1, ymax = maxBound_PC1,
           color = "#55575770", fill = NA, size = 0.5)

final_plot <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(pc_1_2_plot+FocusedAreadRect, 0, 0, 0.9, 0.9) +  # full plot occupies the entire canvas
  # Add square around the focused plot coordinates in the full plot
  draw_plot(pc_1_2_plot_focused, x = 0.57, y = 0.15, width = 0.4, height = 0.4)  # inset position and size

final_plot

# save as png
ggsave("PCA_on_deconstructed_founder_40_RI_graph.png", final_plot, width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 600)

# save as svg
ggsave("PCA_on_deconstructed_founder_40_RI_graph.svg", final_plot, width = 4, height = 4)
```

```{r based on PCs cluster assemblies, include=TRUE, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
Data.MDS.matrix<-as.matrix(Data.MDS[,c(4:10)])

# add rownames
rownames(Data.MDS.matrix)<-Data.MDS$IID

# add space after the rownames
rownames(Data.MDS.matrix)<-paste0(rownames(Data.MDS.matrix), " ")

# calculate distance matrix
Data.MDS.dist<-dist(Data.MDS.matrix, method = "euclidean", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE)

# calculate hierarchical clustering
Data.MDS.hclust<-hclust(Data.MDS.dist, method = "ward.D2")

library(ggtree)
library(ape)

# Convert hclust to phylo object
tree <- as.phylo(Data.MDS.hclust)

# Create a data frame for tip colors
tip_data <- data.frame(label = tree$tip.label)

# Assign default color
tip_data$color <- "#aaaaaa"

# Assign specific colors for labeled groups
tip_data$color[grep("129S1", tip_data$label)] <- "#E69F00"
tip_data$color[grep("A/J", tip_data$label)] <- "#F0E442"
tip_data$color[grep("C57", tip_data$label)] <- "#555555"
tip_data$color[grep("GRCm", tip_data$label)] <- "#555555"
tip_data$color[grep("CAST", tip_data$label)] <- "#009E73"  
tip_data$color[grep("NOD", tip_data$label)] <- "#0072B2"
tip_data$color[grep("NZO", tip_data$label)] <- "#56B4E9"
tip_data$color[grep("PWK", tip_data$label)] <- "#D55E00"
tip_data$color[grep("CC0", tip_data$label)] <- "#8B966C"
tip_data$color[grep("WSB", tip_data$label)] <- "#CC79A7"

tip_data$Group<-tip_data$label
# remove " " from the end of the Group names
tip_data$Group<-gsub(" ", "", tip_data$Group)

# Replace all "CC0" containing entries with "RI"
tip_data$Group[grepl("CC0", tip_data$Group)]<-"RI"

# Replace C57BL/6J/T2T/Keane with C57BL/6J and CAST/EiJ/T2T/Keane with CAST/EiJ
tip_data$Group<-gsub("C57BL/6J/T2T/Keane", "C57BL/6J", tip_data$Group)
tip_data$Group<-gsub("CAST/EiJ/T2T/Keane", "CAST/EiJ", tip_data$Group)

# Replace GRCm39 with C57BL/6J
tip_data$Group<-gsub("GRCm39", "C57BL/6J", tip_data$Group)

# make tip_data$Group a factor
tip_data$Group<-factor(tip_data$Group, levels = c("CAST/EiJ", "PWK/PhJ", "WSB/EiJ", "129S1/SvImJ", "A/J", "C57BL/6J", "NOD/ShiLtJ", "NZO/HlLtJ", "RI"), ordered = TRUE)

# Create a column for font face (default is normal)
tip_data$bold_label <- "plain"

# Make specific labels bold
tip_data$bold_label[grep("CAST|PWK|WSB|C57|NZO|NOD|129S1|A/J", tip_data$label)] <- "bold"

# Plot with colored tip points and bold labels
plot_tree <- ggtree(tree, layout = "circular") %<+% tip_data +  # Attach metadata
  geom_tiplab(aes(fontface = bold_label), size = 1.25, hjust = -0.2) +  # Bold specific labels
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = color, shape=Group), size = 1.55) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = GRAPH_SHAPES) +
  scale_color_identity() +  # Use predefined colors
  theme(legend.position = "fan")

# Display plot
plot_tree
```


```{r sanity check tree, include=TRUE, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
# As a sanity check build the tree excluding the RI lines

# Filter out the RI lines from Data.MDS.matrix
Data.MDS.matrix[!grepl("CC0", rownames(Data.MDS.matrix)),]->Data.MDS.matrix[!grepl("CC0", rownames(Data.MDS.matrix)),]->No_RI_Data.MDS.matrix

# calculate distance matrix
dist(No_RI_Data.MDS.matrix, method = "euclidean")->No_RI_Data.MDS.dist

# calculate hierarchical clustering
hclust(No_RI_Data.MDS.dist, method = "ward.D2")->No_RI_Data.MDS.hclust

# Convert hclust to phylo object
as.phylo(No_RI_Data.MDS.hclust)->No_RI_tree

# Create a data frame for tip colors
data.frame(label = No_RI_tree$tip.label)->No_RI_tip_data

# Assign default color
No_RI_tip_data$color <- "#B2823f75"

# Assign specific colors for labeled groups
No_RI_tip_data$color[grep("CAST", No_RI_tip_data$label)] <- "#7e943590"
No_RI_tip_data$color[grep("PWK", No_RI_tip_data$label)] <- "#447ead90"
No_RI_tip_data$color[grep("WSB", No_RI_tip_data$label)] <- "#C03A4690"

# Create a column for font face (default is normal)
No_RI_tip_data$bold_label <- "plain"

# Make specific labels bold
No_RI_tip_data$bold_label[grep("CAST|PWK|WSB|C57|NZO|NOD|129S1|A/J", No_RI_tip_data$label)] <- "bold"

# Plot with colored tip points and bold labels
ggtree(No_RI_tree, layout = "circular") %<+% No_RI_tip_data +  # Attach metadata
  geom_tiplab(aes(fontface = bold_label), size = 2, hjust = -0.1) +  # Bold specific labels
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = color), size = 1) + 
  scale_color_identity() +  # Use predefined colors
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
